prerequisites: Basic knowledge of mechanics of material and solids
Kinematics and dynamics of rigid bodies

learning_outcomes.text: Provide the knowledge necessary for testing and design in the field of mechanical design.
Provide the principles and basic methodologies that are used in modern engineering for structural and functional design and verification of machines.
Identify whether the problem can be properly simplified or divided into more basic problems.
Appropriately choose materials and construction technologies for the construction of mechanical components.
Use vocabulary and appropriate terminology to present, in written or verbal form, the arguments and results of the study.

syllabus_topics: Basic of Structural analysis and Machine Element Design
Stress Theory of Failure (Rankine’s, Tresca-Guest’s and Huber-Von Mises-Henkey’s theories)
Mechanical material behavior: Relation between Stress and Strain (elastic stress-strain relationships)
assessment_rules: The examination consists of a written and an oral test. The written test involves the design or structural verification of components or simple mechanical systems. The oral discussion will cover course topics and the student's written paper. The final grade will result from both tests as a whole.
bibliography: J.F. Shigley, “Mechanical Engineering Design”, 11/ed: R.G. Budynas and J. K. Nisbett, McGraw-Hill
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
